sloka: हुतवानुपयातो हि देवैरपि सवासवैः।दुराधर्षो भवत्येव सङ्ग्रामे रावणात्मजः ।। ६.८४.१४ ।।
transliteration: hutavānupayāto hi devairapi savāsavaiḥ।durādharṣo bhavatyeva saṅgrāme rāvaṇātmajaḥ ।। 6.84.14 ।।

translations.english: 'He will perform a sacrifice at the sanctuary called Nikumbhila; having offered the oblations and returned, even to the gods together with Indra—'
